quarterly_data.quarter: Everpure press release: Everpure Announces New Data Management Capabilities for (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Product launch: Everpure announced new platform capabilities that it says will be available this October. PureKVA (Key-Value Accelerator): Everpure FlashBlade now pre-stages context directly into GPU memory to deliver up to 20x faster Time to First Token (TTFT) for LLM inference, supporting enterprise multi-tenancy with zero dataset relocation. Also announced: Always-On DeepReduce data compression that continuously scans storage blocks across FlashBlade systems for sub-block similarities so usable capacity expands without impacting write performance; native Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration so AI agents and security tools can query Everpure Data Intelligence's live data catalogs; and an Intelligent Token Optimization reference architecture using open weight models to cut API token usage from external providers.
quarterly_data.figure: PureKVA up to 20x faster Time to First Token; available this October
